data.one_liner: Simple and customizable form dropdown with search and remote data source support.
data.what_it_does: Provides form dropdown widgets with built-in search capabilities, keyboard navigation, and support for both offline and remote data sources. It allows custom display, filtering, and item layout rendering.
use_when: You need a form dropdown with built-in search functionality
You require asynchronous or remote data sources for dropdown options
You need keyboard navigation inside a dropdown list
avoid_when: You only need a basic, standard Flutter DropdownButton without search or async features
You are using a state management approach where you prefer building custom picker dialogs
strengths: Supports search and filtering out of the box
Handles both local lists and asynchronous remote data sources
Highly customizable item layouts and validation support
weaknesses: Relies heavily on dynamic types in its API
Limited documentation outside of README examples
data.minimal_example:
TextDropdownFormField(
    options: ["Male", "Female"],
    decoration: InputDecoration(
        border: OutlineInputBorder(),
        suffixIcon: Icon(Icons.arrow_drop_down),
        labelText: "Gender"),
    dropdownHeight: 120,
)
